commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Augusto Batalla displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
90+3' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' Substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Nico Williams.
87' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) replaces Alex Berenguer.
85' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
84' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

84' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
82' Here is a change. Pep Chavarria is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
82' The linesman raises his flag. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
79' The substitution is prepared. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Inaki Williams.
79' It is time for a substitution. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Jorge de Frutos.
79' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Isi Palazon.
79' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
77' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
76' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
76' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Martinez blows for a foul.
75' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
74' Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul after Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) hacks down one of his opponents.
70' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
69' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
66' 1 - 0 Goal! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Augusto Batalla into the middle of the goal.
66' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
65' The Ath Bilbao players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

64' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Ath Bilbao.
64' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
63' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
62' Close! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
61' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) plays a through ball but overhits it.
58' The game is interrupted as Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside.
58' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
55' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Pedro Diaz is replaced by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Lopez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
55' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Unai Simon scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano). Rayo Vallecano get a corner.
53' CHANCE! Nico Williams finds Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
52' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
49' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Half-time substitution. Ernesto Valverde decided to make a change. Maroan Sannadi is replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 43:57.
42' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Augusto Batalla has no trouble gathering it.
41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
40' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged offside.
38' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
35' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
33' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
32' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
30' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) serves up a nice cross, but Augusto Batalla punches the ball away.
28' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Augusto Batalla keeps it out with an amazing save. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
26' 43:57 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
24' The free kick from long range, taken by Ath Bilbao, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
23' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
22' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
20' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner with a short pass.

20' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post.
19' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
18' Poor challenge! Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Juan Martinez blows his whistle.
15' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
14' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
13' Ath Bilbao are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
11' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
7' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Luiz Felipe (Rayo Vallecano) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
6' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged for offside.
5' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
3' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' A great run from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
2' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Martinez.
